title: Brookfield Place
text: I worked on JavaScript development and the CMS frontend for Brookfield Place’s website. Visitors could explore shops and dining, check upcoming events, and find practical information about the Lower Manhattan destination. The site also published editorial stories about what was happening there. A visitor map showed stores across different levels, with controls for changing floors and opening location details. The project brought regularly changing content and location information together, giving people a place to plan a visit and discover more once they arrived.
summary: For Brookfield Place’s website, I worked on JavaScript and the CMS frontend, bringing shopping, dining, events, and visitor information together for the Lower Manhattan destination.
